en.headline: Development Bureau submits Queen Mary Hospital lifts investigation report
en.dek: The bureau said it has given the report to the Chief Executive, who requested further details on rectification work, with 17 lifts repaired and seven now in use.
body: The Development Bureau said on Monday that it had submitted its investigation report on the defective lifts at Queen Mary Hospital's new Clinical Block to the Chief Executive.

The Chief Executive has asked for further information on the rectification works and subsequent actions. The bureau said it is providing that material and will report the findings to the Legislative Council Panel on Development as soon as possible.

Seventeen lifts have completed repairs, and seven of those have been accepted and opened for staff and public use according to hospital needs. The remaining repairs are expected to be finished within the fourth quarter. The contractor has funded lift operators for newly opened units to improve communication with passengers.

zh.headline: 發展局已向特首提交瑪麗醫院升降機調查報告
zh.dek: 局方指已提交報告，特首要求提供執修及後續行動進一步資料，17部升降機完成執修，7部已開放使用。
body: 發展局周一表示，已向行政長官提交有關瑪麗醫院新臨床大樓升降機問題的調查報告。
行政長官要求就執修工作及後續行動提供進一步資料。局方正按要求提交資料，並會盡快向立法會發展事務委員會匯報調查結果。
至今有17部升降機完成執修，其中7部經驗收後已按醫院需要開放予員工及公眾使用。餘下執修預計第四季內完成。承建商自資為剛投入服務的升降機提供控制員，以加強與乘客溝通。
